regime_context: Hong Kong's thematic detector narrows to 5 eligible themes (out of 17), led by Tech Hardware & Semis with moderate durability (0.62) but low breadth (0.167). No eligible theme has a scorable ETF proxy; the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true) provides the only validated edge—risk control through avoidance of ineligible themes. Momentum ranks are a focus lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Tech Hardware & Semis: watch for loss of eligibility (durability dropping below trend-gate threshold) as a potential exhaustion signal. Kill criterion: theme becomes ineligible for two consecutive weeks.
